help.stdout:
usage: gnd measure [-h] [--promote DIR] --populations POPULATIONS [--out OUT]
                   [--format {text,json}]
                   model

Measure the checker's per-constraint false-pass, false-fail and undecided
rates over labelled synthetic populations. Reads the populations `gnd synth`
wrote and their provenance sidecars, verifies the C6 sidecar binding before
scoring, and emits a per-constraint report — three rates, each with its
numerator AND its conditional denominator (C2), never a blended accuracy
number (D-01). Computed OFFLINE from committed artifacts: no timestamp, so two
runs over one corpus reproduce byte-for-byte. Exits 3 on a sidecar-binding
mismatch, 5 on a population that fails to load, 6 on a checker defect (C9), 64
on a corpus mixing models or pool sources (C4).

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --promote DIR         D-14: copy each defect-revealing population and its
                        model into DIR (the adversarial corpus root) and PRINT
                        manifest rows in the locked record shape. The append
                        itself stays a reviewed act — this never edits
                        manifest.yaml
  --populations POPULATIONS
                        output root of a `gnd synth` run (the directory
                        holding index.json)
  --out OUT             write the JSON payload to this path (default: stdout)
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload
